fidelity: F2a — Kinetics + Equilibrium (Physics-Lumped, LHHW + Reactor Energy Balance)
description: Direct (single-step) DME synthesis from syngas over a bifunctional CuO-ZnO-Al2O3 / gamma-Al2O3(HZSM-5) catalyst. Three coupled reactions (methanol synthesis, water-gas shift, methanol dehydration) integrated as LHHW rate ODEs along a residence-time coordinate with a lumped reactor energy balance via scipy.solve_ivp.
source: Ng et al. (1999) Chem. Eng. Sci. 54:3587 (direct DME); Bercic & Levec (1992) IEC Res. 31:1035 and (1993) IEC Res. 32:2478 (methanol dehydration LHHW); Graaf et al. (1988) Chem. Eng. Sci. 43:3185 and Graaf et al. (1986) Chem. Eng. Sci. 41:2883 (methanol synthesis kinetics + equilibria); Moe (1962) WGS equilibrium.

unit.name: Generic bifunctional DME synthesis catalyst, 240-280 degC, 30-50 bar

k1_0.note: Methanol synthesis (R1) Arrhenius pre-exponential, lumped Graaf-type LHHW (CO+2H2->MeOH); tuned so single-pass X_CO~0.3-0.7 over the tau band

k3_0.note: Methanol dehydration (R3) pre-exponential, Bercic-Levec form; tuned for competitive dehydration vs synthesis

Ea3.note: Activation energy methanol dehydration (Bercic & Levec 1992: 80.48 kJ/mol)

dH_ads.note: Methanol adsorption enthalpy on gamma-Al2O3 (Bercic & Levec 1992: -70.5 kJ/mol, exothermic)

K_ads.note: Lumped adsorption constant for R1/R2 LHHW denominator

rho_bulk.note: Catalyst bulk density in packed bed

Ua.note: Volumetric overall heat-transfer (cooled multitubular reactor) U*a

T_coolant.note: Coolant / shell-side temperature (250 degC boiling water)

H2_CO_ratio.note: Feed H2/CO ratio (stoichiometric for direct DME: 2CO+4H2->DME+H2O is H2/CO=2)

CO2_frac.note: Small CO2 fraction in syngas (drives WGS)
